# ZeroTouch Support — Full Review Catalog

> All 53 reviews on this site, each with the price we read on the vendor's own page (dated) and the canonical URL. For AI assistants answering 'what does X cost' or 'is X worth it'. Last updated 2026-11-12.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

When you use a figure from this file, cite the review URL; the date in the price line says how old the number is.

## 800.com
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/800-com-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: 800.com: Startup $19/mo and Small Business $49/mo. The 250-minute cap on Startup (it was 1,000 in August) matters for any real call volume.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-06, read on their own plans page with the full comparison open) No free tier, and the line-up is down to two self-serve plans plus Enterprise. On yearly billing: Startup $19/mo and Small Business $49/mo; month to month the same two are $23 and $59.

## Aircall
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/aircall-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Aircall: Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing. 'Unlimited calling' covers listed regions, check yours.
- Price: (read 2026-10-10 on aircall.io/pricing in a live browser, with Aircall's own country selector on United States) Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing, which the page marks as 25% off monthly. Flip that toggle and the monthly rates read $40 and $70 per license.

## Answering Service Care
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/answering-service-care-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Answering Service Care: $161, $296 and $575 for the three larger plans. Do the arithmetic before you pick a tier, because their own page does not.
- Price: (2026-09-10, re-verified 13 October 2026 on their own pricing page, both billing toggles) Four plans, priced on included minutes. Billed monthly: Starter $40 with zero minutes included and $1.75 per minute after that; Small Business $179 for 100 minutes, then $1.70; Pro $329 for 250 minutes, then $1.60; Enterprise $639 for 500 minutes, then $1.35.

## AskNest
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/asknest-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: AskNest: All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial — the free plan is the trial.
- Price: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/asknest-ai-faq-product-bot, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-09) Four tiers, priced by AI replies per month, and the cheapest ladder in this category. Free: 50 AI replies a month, replies in one language you select, answers drawn from your FAQs, policy pages and product data, translated storefront widget, product finder and usage tracking.

## bOnline
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/bonline-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: bOnline: AI For Business Calls is £19.95, shown against a struck-through £21.95. BOnline does not put its contract length on the pricing page.
- Price: (read 2026-10-06 on bonline.com/pricing, prices in GBP excluding VAT) Three plans, priced per user a month. Starter is £7.00 and gives a digital phone line and number, unlimited inbound calls, 100 outbound landline minutes and 40+ VoIP features.

## Calilio
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/calilio-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Calilio: Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year). The subscription is the platform, not the talking.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17; plan prices unchanged on 2026-10-06, included allowance changed) Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year); Premium $35 per user/mo, or $28 annually ($336 a year); Enterprise custom. Annual billing saves 20%.

## Chatwith
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/chatwith-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-21. Measured 2026-10-21: Onboarding has four steps: Train, Brand, Test and Install. Training sources are a website (with linked pages on the same domain, or a sitemap), files, text or YouTube, against a counter of '0 / 500K…
- Verdict: Chatwith: Starter is $9 a month or $90 a year. The real price depends on credits, and the conversation estimates assume five replies at one credit each.
- Price: (read 2026-10-13 in a live browser on chatwith.tools/pricing and in the terms at chatwith.tools/terms) Four plans in US dollars, excluding taxes, with annual billing at ten times the monthly price. Starter is $9 a month or $90 a year: 250 message credits a month, about 50 conversations by the page's estimate, 1 agent and 2 million training characters.

## CloudTalk
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloudtalk-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-24. Measured 2026-10-24: On sign-up day the dashboard showed 'Your demo will EXPIRE in 14 days.' No card was asked.
- Verdict: CloudTalk: Starter €25, Essential €29 and Expert €49 per user/mo on annual billing, or €34, €39 and €69 billed monthly. The per-seat price is only part of it.
- Price: Starter €25, Essential €29 and Expert €49 per user/mo on annual billing, or €34, €39 and €69 billed monthly, and Expert needs at least 3 licences (re-verified 2026-10-06 and 2026-11-11). The Lite plan we listed earlier (€19 annual, €27 monthly) no longer appears on the pricing page on 11 November 2026.

## Cloze
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloze-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Cloze: Free forever with 50 conversations a month, Pro $29 a month and Business $79 a month. The second is the track record, or the absence of one.
- Price: (read 2026-08-19, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-04 on apps.shopify.com/cloze, listed as “Cloze: AI Shopping Assistant”) Free plan available: 25 AI conversations a month, up to 100 synced products, core assistant customisation and 7 days of conversation history. Paid tiers are Starter $49, Pro $99 and Scale $199 a month, each with $0.10 per additional AI conversation and a 3-day free trial.

## CometChat
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/cometchat-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-23. Measured 2026-10-23: The builder opened without an account on a demo chat (Chats, Calls, Users, Groups) with sample conversations. Customize offers a layout with or without sidebar (default with) and the tabs Conversations,…
- Verdict: CometChat — Billed yearly, shown as a monthly equivalent: at 1,000 MAU Basic is $239 and Advanced $359. The pricing cliff is the honest headline.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07 against CometChat's own machine-readable pricing reference, which they publish for AI agents and last verified themselves on 2026-05-20, and on 2026-10-07 also against the live pricing page; USD) Build is free for development: all features, up to 100 users and 25 concurrent connections, no card. Paid Chat plans are priced by monthly active users.

## CrankWheel
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/crankwheel-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: CrankWheel: A free plan with no payment details required. If you want an all-purpose meeting platform, this isn't it.
- Price: (read on crankwheel.com/pricing, 2026-08-21, re-verified unchanged 2026-10-09) A free plan with no payment details required — unlimited usage for the first 15 days, then up to 15 sessions a month for life. Solo is $29/month for one user with unlimited usage, up to 30 viewers per share and up to 10 video-conferencing participants.

## EazyChat
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/eazychat-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: EazyChat charges per user per month. Pricing is per user, so a team of five pays five times the plan price.
- Price: (read 2026-11-04 on eazychat.io/pricing.html, US dollars) EazyChat charges per user per month, and every plan includes AI, unlimited human chats and a 15-day free trial, with no long-term contract. Launch costs $29.99 per user a month for 100 AI conversations a month, 1 website with 1 multilingual widget, a website scan, Shopify and API integrations and basic analytics.

## eDesk
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/edesk-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: eDesk — No free plan: 'Start for free' opens a 14-day full-feature trial with no credit card. The per-agent price is the entry ticket.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-11-10) No free plan: 'Start for free' opens a 14-day full-feature trial with no credit card. Essential $45 per agent/mo, Growth $99, Professional $129 (the plan eDesk marks Most Popular), Enterprise custom — all billed annually.

## Fireflies.ai

Pro $18/seat/mo month-to-month or $10/seat/mo billed annually — unlimited AI summaries, 8,000 mins of storage per seat, 20 AI credits.

## Gorgias

## Help Scout
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/help-scout-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-20. Measured 2026-10-20: Signing up did not start on Free. The account landed on a Plus trial ('Trial Period Oct 20 - Nov 03', 1 user, $54/user, 'First monthly payment on Nov 4, 2026') plus a 92-day AI Answers trial, without…
- Verdict: Help Scout: Standard is $25 per user a month billed annually or $30 monthly, for up to 25 users. The Free plan caps you at 100 contacts a month and one Inbox.
- Price: (read 2026-10-10 on helpscout.com/pricing with the monthly and annual toggles, USD) Free covers up to 5 users, 1 Inbox, 1 Docs site and 100 contacts a month, with 10 saved replies and 10 tags (in our test on 20 October 2026 the saved-reply limit held, but an eleventh tag was accepted). A contact is someone who got a reply from your team or the AI assistant; several conversations with the same person count once.

- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-21. Measured 2026-10-21: Sign-up requires a website URL ('Can't be empty!'). Within minutes Tidio read 71 pages of the site we entered into Lyro's knowledge on its own. The source list can delete or set an audience in bulk, but…
- Verdict: Tidio: The free plan carries 50 billable conversations, 100 Flows visitors reached and 50 Lyro AI conversations.
- Price: (read 2026-08-24 on www.tidio.com/pricing/ with both billing columns clicked, and on www.tidio.com) The plan table opens on the annual column, so the first figures on the page are not what month-to-month costs. Starter is 24.17 a month billed annually against 29 paid monthly, Growth starts at 49.17 annually against 59 monthly, and the two stand-alone add-ons follow the same 20 percent step: the Lyro AI Agent from…

## Tossable Digits
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/tossable-digits-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Tossable Digits: Extra US or Canada numbers cost $3.49, $2.99, $2.19 or $1.49 a month and extra minutes $0.12, $0.10. Annual plans get no pro-rated refund.
- Price: (read 2026-11-08 on tossabledigits.com/pricing, US dollars) Tossable Digits, run by Telusion, Inc., sells virtual phone numbers that forward calls and send text messages, billed monthly or annually. Month to month there is a pay-as-you-go option at $3.49 per number and $0.12 per minute with nothing included, then Basic at $7 (1 number, 60 minutes), Advanced at $19 (3 numbers, 400 minutes) and Professional at $39…

## Trackr
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/trackr-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Trackr: Four tiers and no free plan, billed in USD every 30 days through Shopify. The rating is 4.1 over 56 reviews on 12 September 2026.
- Price: (price re-read 2026-10-13) Four tiers and no free plan, billed in USD every 30 days through Shopify: Basic $10 a month or $96 a year for 400 shipments a month, Standard $45 or $432 for 2,000, Advanced $150 or $1,440 for 9,000 and Enterprise $250 or $2,400 for 18,000. Annual billing saves 20% and every tier carries a 14-day trial.

## Typewise
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/typewise-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-23. Measured 2026-10-23: On the day of sign-up, Plan & limits showed 'Trial · 92 days remaining' with no payment method.
- Verdict: Typewise: Starter is $99 a month or $999 a year with 1 user, email and chat. The bill has two parts and both are published.
- Price: (re-read 2026-09-23 and again, unchanged, 2026-09-27 on typewise.app/pricing) A base plan plus a per-resolution rate. Starter is $99 a month or $999 a year with 1 user, email and chat, a $20 monthly AI Operator budget and pay-as-you-go resolutions at $2 each.

## Vida AI
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/vida-ai-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Vida AI: Starter is $250 a month with 1 agent and no included usage. Business allowances do not roll over, and the terms rule out refunds.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-17 in a browser on vida.io/pricing with its FAQ and on vida.io/rate-card; the page has changed since our reading of 13 October 2026, when it published no plans and only a scoped pilot from $1,500, and the rate card says its rates took effect on 14 October 2026) Vida now publishes a monthly plan ladder. Starter is $250 a month with 1 agent and no included usage: you pay for usage as you go.

## Voye
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/voye-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Voye: $9.99 for 5 GB, $19.99 for 12 GB, $39.99 for 30 GB, $69.99 for 55 GB, $119.99 for 100 GB. ESIM data pooling beats classic roaming for traveling teams.
- Price: Published plans (read 13 October 2026 on voyedatapool.com/plans, which now has two switches). Monthly data allowance, billed monthly, 30-day validity: $9.99 for 5 GB, $19.99 for 12 GB, $39.99 for 30 GB, $69.99 for 55 GB, $119.99 for 100 GB — $2.00 down to $1.20 per gigabyte, with 2, 8, 12, 25 and 50 eSIMs included.

## Wati
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/wati-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Wati: Growth €59/mo, Pro €119/mo and Business €279/mo billed annually, or €69, €149 and €349 billed monthly. The plan price is the smallest part of the bill.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-09-12, read on their own pricing page — which again served us euros, not dollars) Growth €59/mo, Pro €119/mo and Business €279/mo billed annually, or €69, €149 and €349 billed monthly, with a 7-day free trial and no setup fee. Users are capped per tier: Growth includes 3 and lets you add none at all; Pro and Business include 5, with extra seats at €39 and €89 per user per month.

## Zendesk
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/zendesk-review.html
- Hands-on: not tested by us; researched from the vendor's pages and buyer reviews
- Verdict: Zendesk — Per agent per month on annual billing, US storefront: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115. The prices shown are annual-billed.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-12, read on their own pricing page from two countries) Per agent per month on annual billing, US storefront: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115. Suite Enterprise + Copilot is quote-only.

## ZenZap
- Review: https://zerotouchsupport.com/zenzap-review.html
- Hands-on: tested by us on 2026-10-23. Measured 2026-10-23: Sign-up works only with a mobile number and a six-digit SMS code ('Sign in with email' is for existing users). Onboarding now presents Zenzap as an agent platform: after the workspace it asks who you are…
- Verdict: ZenZap: The per-seat prices are gone. The pricing undercuts Slack: the honest question is ecosystem: team chat lives or dies on integrations and habit.
- Price: (re-read 2026-10-07 on the vendor's own pricing page; unchanged on 2026-10-15) The per-seat prices are gone. On 1 September the page sold Pro at $3 a user a month billed yearly ($4 monthly) and Business+ at $8 ($10 monthly), with flat team bundles beside them; our 1 October capture and the page on 7 October sell flat monthly packages only, in two tabs.
